name: discobox-mcp
description: Launch and work with Discobox boxes through live terminals, files, and desktop views.

endpoint.title: Connection override (optional)
endpoint.description: Leave blank for guided setup and the saved profile, or the default local endpoint on first launch. Advanced: pin a Unix socket/Windows named pipe, HTTP(S) API origin, or enrolled discobox:// peer. An override disables profile editing in the widget.

project.title: Project override (optional)
project.description: Leave blank to use the setup widget and its saved profile (default project: default). A nonempty override pins this launcher configuration.

api_token.title: Discobox API token (if required)
api_token.description: Optional upstream Discobox API credential, sent only to the Connection override endpoint; ignored when that is blank. This is not the bearer token for a separately running MCP adapter.
